name: Game Boy / Game Boy Color
description: The iconic brick that defined portable gaming for a generation. Game Boy Color added color without sacrificing backward compatibility.
notableGames: Tetris, Pokémon Red/Blue, The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX

name: Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
description: The system that revived the North American video game market after the 1983 crash. Famous for its front-loading cartridge design.
notableGames: Super Mario Bros. 3, The Legend of Zelda, Metroid, Mega Man 2

name: Super Nintendo (SNES)
description: 16-bit powerhouse known for its vibrant color palette and Mode 7 scaling effects. The pinnacle of 2D gaming.
notableGames: Super Mario World, The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, Super Metroid, Chrono Trigger

name: Sega Genesis
description: Sega's 16-bit answer to Nintendo, marketed as the cooler, edgier alternative with 'Blast Processing' and attitude.
notableGames: Sonic the Hedgehog 2, Streets of Rage 2, Phantasy Star IV, Gunstar Heroes

name: TurboGrafx-16 / PC Engine
description: First 16-bit console to market, though used a modified 8-bit CPU. Hugely popular in Japan as the PC Engine.
notableGames: R-Type, Bonk's Adventure, Splatterhouse, Ys Book I & II

name: Neo Geo AES
description: The ultimate 'arcade perfect' home console. Prohibitively expensive but delivered exact arcade quality at home.
notableGames: Samurai Shodown II, Metal Slug, The King of Fighters '98, Fatal Fury Special

name: Sony PlayStation
description: The disc-based revolution that shifted the industry away from cartridges and brought gaming to the masses.
notableGames: Final Fantasy VII, Metal Gear Solid, Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, Tekken 3

name: Sega Saturn
description: Complex dual-CPU architecture made development challenging, but hosted incredible 2D fighters and unique Japanese titles.
notableGames: Nights into Dreams, Panzer Dragoon Saga, Guardian Heroes, Virtua Fighter 2

name: Virtual Boy
description: Nintendo's infamous stereoscopic 3D tabletop console. Red monochrome display and notorious for causing headaches.
notableGames: Virtual Boy Wario Land, Mario's Tennis, Teleroboxer

name: Neo Geo Pocket / Color
description: Incredible fighting game handheld with a clicky microswitched joystick. Excellent battery life and build quality.
notableGames: SNK vs. Capcom: Match of the Millennium, Metal Slug 1st Mission, Faselei!

name: WonderSwan / Color
description: Designed by Game Boy creator Gunpei Yokoi's final company. Huge in Japan but never released internationally.
notableGames: Final Fantasy I-IV, Judgement Silversword, Makaimura for WonderSwan

name: Game Boy Advance
description: Final major 2D-focused Nintendo handheld with SNES-level power and full backward compatibility with Game Boy library.
notableGames: Metroid Fusion, Advance Wars, The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap, Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow
